How much of NUT is wrapped?

The wrapper is a state partition of the single NUT supply. The headline metric is how much of the conserved root currently exists as wNUT.

One root. Two liquid states.

wNUT does not create new NUT. It represents the portion deposited into the wrapper. The state is legible through outstanding wNUT ↔ underlying NUT backing.

Interaction warning

Do not send NUT directly to the wrapper.

Direct ERC-20 transfers of NUT to the wNUT contract do not mint wNUT. Correct wrapping uses approve → depositFor(). The observatory surfaces any resulting backing surplus because surplus is economically distinct from outstanding wNUT.
